fields.question: What is Search Guard?
fields.answer: Search Guard is an Enterprise Security Suite that encrypts and protects your data and data flows in the entire Elastic Stack, including Kibana, Logstash and Beats.

fields.question: Who is using Search Guard?
fields.answer: A wide variety of enterprises, from Fortune 500 companies to the most innovative start-ups around the world, are trusting in Search Guard to secure their environments. Our customers include leading companies from the finance, healthcare, telecommunications, big data, legal and aerospace sectors. We also work together with governmental agencies and provide security for scientific and educational institutions.

fields.question: Is your code secure and audited?
fields.answer:
Yes, the complete code base of Search Guard is constantly audited for security issues by ourselves and independent security experts of our customers.

Search Guard is also verified by CA Veracode. We use Veracode's patented static binary analysis technology that inspects software executables (compiled binaries or bytecode) for security flaws. Through advanced modeling, Veracode’s static engine detects flaws in the software's inputs and outputs that cannot be seen through penetration testing alone. Unlike source code review tools, this approach accurately detects issues in the core application and extends coverage to vulnerabilities found in 3rd party libraries, pre-packaged components, and code introduced by compiler or platform-specific interpretations.

fields.question: What is your licensing model?
fields.answer:
Search Guard is dual licensed. All basic security features in the Community Edition are free, while you need to obtain a license in order to use the Enterprise or Compliance Edition in production.
We license Search Guard per production cluster, not number of nodes. The regular license has no limits regarding the number of nodes, so you can scale your cluster indefinitely without additional costs. All other systems, like development, staging, integration, test and the like are included in the license. Scale your cluster, not your cost!
We also offer discounted licenses for small installations with 5 nodes or less. [Get in contact with us](https://search-guard.com/contacts/) and we will work out a licensing model that fits your needs.

fields.question: My company is non-profit, do you offer any discounts?
fields.answer: Absolutely. We want to give back to education and science and provide special discounts and free licenses for eligible institutions. [Get in touch with us](https://search-guard.com/contacts/) to learn more about our education & scientific licensing.
